given: a stock record whose batch_number and serial_number are both NULL (a code that did not parse during the migration)
when: an API client fetches that stock record
then: the response includes the batch_number and serial_number fields both present and explicitly null, not omitted and not substituted with a combined string

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 assert value-bearing rows expose their fields; this AC asserts the null-handling outcome for unparsed rows. An implementation that returns values but omits null fields (or renders them as an empty/combined string) passes AC1/AC2 yet fails here, so it is independently breakable.
